title: Every node this NodePool owns is replaced after the upgrade

detection.reason: the new hash marks EVERY existing node drifted, so any NodePool with nodes is affected — there is no narrower predicate to apply

quote: This version adds support for drift on CA bundle. The updated hashing logic will mark existing nodes as drifted.
remediation: Expect fleet-wide node replacement. The CA-bundle hashing change marks every existing node as drifted, so Karpenter replaces the lot. Set `spec.disruption.budgets` on these NodePools first if that churn needs a ceiling, and schedule the upgrade when a full roll is acceptable.
verifyCommand: kubectl get nodeclaims --no-headers 2>/dev/null | wc -l; kubectl get nodepools -o json 2>/dev/null | jq -r '.items[]? | "\(.metadata.name) budgets=\((.spec.disruption.budgets // []) | length)"'  # every node counted is replaced on upgrade, and a NodePool with 0 budgets has no ceiling on that churn
